results.name: type + click + verify + finish on a real page, via the dispatcher
real stale element: the page is re-rendered between observation and click
new tab opened by a click: the agent notices it and switches back
approval gate: approve, deny, and stop while waiting
pause freezes the page, resume continues, stop cancels a slow model call
restricted start page: the agent navigates away; insisting on the page fails cleanly
login form: credentials are never typed; the task waits for the user and resumes
CAPTCHA page: the agent stops and hands over; no model call while it blocks
provider failure falls back to the next provider in a real task
side panel drives a task end to end (start, approval buttons, result)
long page: the agent jumps to the text with find_text instead of scrolling blindly, then reads around it
voice input (Phase 2.1): mic -> Task box -> the EXISTING Run path -> task engine; empty speech and risky commands behave like typed ones
Business Brain: 'Fill in my business name and business address.' -> tokens -> exact values typed in real Chrome; nothing private reaches the model, logs, history or audit
Business Brain via VOICE: spoken transcript -> existing Run path -> context resolver -> exact values typed (scripted recogniser, real microphone track)
Business Brain panel in real Chrome: masked profile, explicit temporary reveal, Confirm for an unverified value, tabs, terminal-only access changes
Client Brain: 'Fill in the selected client's business information.' for client A then client B in real Chrome: the right client's exact values, no cross-client or owner data anywhere
Client Brain panel in real Chrome: Clients tab, masked client profile, client documents/SEO views, per-task Client box, picking the client when the task asks
Business Brain feature flag OFF (the default): no section, no per-task switch, no database, a token is refused
Spreadsheet import -> Client Brain -> a client task in real Chrome: the workbook's exact values are typed; the instruction-like cells stay data; no value reaches the model, logs, history or audit
Spreadsheet import panel in real Chrome: the Imports tab previews a workbook chosen through a real file input (masked, nothing saved) and offers no way to import
Knowledge Hub: the browser agent (and so a model) cannot read, click, type, scroll or screenshot the Hub in real Chrome; a task that tries fails cleanly
